scientific_integrity: Two independently implemented exhaustive graph constructions and direct exact-dynamic-program/cross-check calculations are provided as source and complete data. The resulting claim remains subject to independent scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification only for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles, modulo rotation; no general-order theorem and no established historical uniqueness. Earlier general circular-word and reverse-complement results must not be conflated with this joint table.
title: Joint circular palindrome and antipalindrome deletion spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
